newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar rises above 1.8400 marks in late Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Dollar rises above 1.8400 marks in late Tokyo.

text.p: The dollar rose above 1.8400 marks in late Tokyo trade on Friday, its highest level since July 1991, bankers said.
Speculative dollar buying intensified in late trade, pushing the U.S. currency up as high as 1.8405 marks, dealers said.
Dealers said heavy purchases of the dollar against the Swiss franc led the upward trend, with the trend quickly spilling into dollar/mark trade.

"The dollar's rapid uptrend was exaggerated due to market thinness in late Tokyo. The undertone of the mark and the Swiss franc remain vulnerable against the dollar, following overnight falls," a Japanese city bank dealer said.
At 0724 GMT, the dollar stood at 1.5155/60 Swiss francs.
The dollar was at 1.8343/45 marks and 1.5060/70 Swiss francs in early Tokyo trade.
